ria: Quick note: ranky-7b-int4-q variant shows ~4.8% NDCG@10 drop on ultra-short queries (<6 tokens) vs fp16.
ken: command and model tag?
ria: `python eval.py --model ranky-7b-int4-q --dataset short_holdout --k 10 --slice ultra_short --seed 11`
ada: does MRR move similarly?
ria: MRR ~ -1.3%, P@1 -2.0. Looks like score compression on top candidates.
ken: try a simple post-quant scale on logits (x1.2) and re-run a 1k sample to see recovery.
ria: on it. Also emitting per-query traces with `--emit-score-trace` to inspect gaps.
